verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Ramp shipping its own MCP servers (Ramp MCP, Developer MCP, Data MCP) for external AI assistants like Claude/ChatGPT to consume Ramp's tools — i.e., Ramp acting as the MCP server/provider. There is no evidence that Ramp itself can act as an MCP client, letting a user plug in third-party MCP servers so Ramp's own AI/automation features could use their tools.
